question: What kinds of content am I forbidden from posting?
expected_answer: Offensive, obscene, indecent, pornographic, lewd, suggestive, sexually explicit; violence; blasphemous or hateful content
answer_text: You are forbidden from posting content that is offensive, obscene, indecent, pornographic, lewd, suggestive, or sexually explicit. You are also forbidden from depicting violence in an explicit, graphic, or gratuitous manner. The content must not be blasphemous, in breach of racial or religious hatred or discrimination legislation. It must not be deceptive, fraudulent, threatening, abusive, harassing, anti-social, menacing, hateful, discriminatory, or inflammatory. The content must not cause annoyance, inconvenience, or needless anxiety to any person, nor constitute spam. Your content must not be illegal or unlawful, infringe any person's legal rights, or be capable of giving rise to legal action against any person. Your content must not infringe or breach any copyright, moral right, database right, trademark right, design right, right in passing off, or other intellectual property right. It must not infringe or breach any right of confidence, right of privacy, or right under data protection legislation. It must not infringe or breach any contractual obligation owed to any person, or any court order. You must not submit to our marketplace any material that is or has ever been the subject of any threatened or actual legal proceedings or other similar complaint. You must not use the review function or any other form of communication to provide inaccurate, inauthentic, or fake reviews. You must not interfere with a transaction by contacting another user to buy or sell an item listed on the marketplace outside of the marketplace, or by communicating with a user involved in an active or completed transaction to warn them away from a particular buyer, seller, or item. You must not send personal information including credit card details.

question: What is the full returns procedure from request to refund?
expected_answer: Contact call centre, 3 pickup attempts in 2 working days, quality check, refund per requested method within 2 days
answer_text:
The full returns procedure from request to refund involves the following steps:

1. The customer must contact the Customer Service Call Center at 0742511381 or 0742511394 and fill out a return form. 

2. The customer has 2 days from the day they received their purchase to notify Kibuga of their return. For defective items, they are advised to contact the manufacturer if the product has a warranty.

3. Kibuga will make 3 attempts within 2 working days to pick up the returning item. If the item is not picked up after these attempts, the return procedure is canceled, and the customer will not be able to return the product. The customer can also drop off the return item at Kibuga's offices or warehouse.

4. The package must be in good condition; otherwise, it will be rejected by the rider during collection or sent back after a quality check.

5. Kibuga will keep the customer updated by email and SMS about the status of their return.

6. If the return is valid, Kibuga will refund the customer according to the requested refund method. The process may take up to 2 days from when the return request was submitted.

7. If the return is invalid, Kibuga will call the customer to explain the issue and send the item(s) back to them. They will make two (2) attempts to return the product to the customer at no cost. If these attempts fail, the product will be stored at Kibuga's warehouse for up to seven (7) days. If the customer does not collect the product within these seven (7) days, it will be deemed forfeited and disposed of according to Ugandan law.

question: How does Kibuga handle a seller's money — what gets deducted and what's left?
expected_answer: Kibuga collects buyer payments, deducts commissions (a % of VAT-inclusive selling price), fees, taxes, penalties, refunds and other owed amounts, then remits the remainder.
answer_text:
According to the context, Kibuga handles a seller's money as follows: 

- All amounts stated on the marketplace are stated inclusive of VAT and any other taxes applicable to the transaction. Commissions are calculated as a percentage of the selling price (inclusive of VAT and any other taxes charged to the buyer) and are inclusive of VAT and all other taxes thereon. 

- In the event of any upwards revision in the rate of VAT or any other applicable taxes, the amount of the commission shall be automatically adjusted to ensure that Kibuga’s net revenues remain constant. 

- The seller is exclusively liable in respect of all taxes applicable to the transactions, and is responsible for the reporting, filing, and payment of the same. 

- Kibuga may make tax-related deductions to payments processed by us on your behalf and remit such deducted amounts to the relevant government or tax authority. 

- The seller must supply any information and documentation that Kibuga may reasonably request in order to identify them or facilitate compliance with legal obligations relating to taxation. 

- The seller warrants that the products are of satisfactory quality, fit and safe for any purpose specified, and conform in all material respects to the product listing. 

- The seller is responsible for the products and must have good title to, and be the sole legal and beneficial owner of, the products, and that the products are not subject to any third-party rights or restrictions. 

From this, it can be inferred that Kibuga handles a seller's money by deducting taxes and any other applicable charges, and the commission is calculated based on the selling price inclusive of those taxes, with adjustments made if there are changes in tax rates to maintain Kibuga's net revenues. The remaining amount after deductions would be the commission paid to the seller, subject to the terms and conditions outlined.

question: Walk me through everything I need to know to return an item and get my money back.
expected_answer: Notify within 2 days by calling Customer Service with proof of purchase and original packaging; Kibuga makes 3 pickup attempts in 2 working days; no shipping charge; no returns after 2 days; gifts must be returned.
answer_text:
To return an item and get your money back, follow these steps:

1. Notify Kibuga of your return within 2 days from the day you received your purchase by calling Customer Service at 0742511381 or 0742511394.

2. Ensure that the package of the returning item is in good condition. If it is damaged, it will be rejected by the rider during collection or sent back after quality check is done.

3. We will make 3 attempts within 2 working days to pick-up the returning item after you submit the return request. If the item is not picked up after 3 attempts, you will not be able to return your product to us anymore.

4. If your returned product is not validated for refund, we will call you to explain the issue and send the item(s) back to you. We will arrange the delivery of the item at no cost. However, after two (2) failed attempts, we will cancel the return process and store the product at our warehouse for up to seven (7) days awaiting your collection. If you do not collect the product within these seven (7) days, it will be deemed as forfeited and we will dispose off in accordance with the Ugandan law.

5. Once you have returned the item, we will perform a careful quality check. If the claim is valid, we will refund you according to your requested refund method. The process may take up to 2 days from when your return request was submitted. If the claim is invalid, the item will be sent back to you.

6. You must return any gift with the product. There are no charges for shipping a product back to Kibuga.
